text: All right, lastly, I want a new card. Ready to hand over. The mastermind is spawning nothing more. Minions are still working. My question is, what is the state of our assistant and master assistant system? I don't think we have a master assistant right now, although we could. So my assistant here, Sonnet, do you have the ability to spawn minions?
